maint.description: Operator commands for the gateway log database (SQLite): inspect, prune, reset.
maint.db: path of the SQLite file (default: database_path in config.yml)
maint.stats: show row counts, time range, size and indexes
maint.prune: delete records older than N days (explicit operation)
maint.before_days: delete records older than this many days
maint.vacuum_opt: VACUUM afterwards to shrink the file
maint.reset: delete every record and VACUUM (explicit operation)
maint.confirm: This deletes {what} from {db} (DNS / firewall / proxy logs; the relay audit is separate).
maint.not_vacuumed: not vacuumed (add --vacuum to shrink the file)
maint.reload_follow: open the reload window, so saving config.yml applies again
maint.reload_freeze: close the reload window now (run before handing the session to an agent)
maint.reload_duration: how long to keep it open (default 30m)
maint.reload_frozen: reload window closed. Saving config.yml no longer applies.
maint.reload_following: reload window open for {duration}. Saving config.yml applies until it runs out.
maint.reload_bad_duration: not a duration: {value}. Use something like 30m, 2h, 90s.
maint.reload_write_failed: could not record the reload window; it is unchanged. Check the log for the reason.
